escalations.title: proxy-addr IPv4-mapped IPv6 IP spoofing — CVSS 9.1
escalations.detail: Express transitive dependency proxy-addr <2.0.8 allows spoofing IPv4 addresses via ::ffff:127.0.0.1 format, bypassing IP-based access controls or rate limiting. Affects Backend and Orchestrator.

escalations.title: handlebars JavaScript injection via AST type confusion
escalations.detail: Handlebars AST tampering via malformed @partial-block directives allows injection of arbitrary JavaScript during template compilation. Affects Backend build toolchain; risk elevated if any templates compiled from untrusted input.
escalations.fix: Update build dependency chain (npm update in Backend)

escalations.title: tinypool prototype pollution → RCE in CI worker threads
escalations.detail: Vitest's tinypool <4.1.x allows malicious worker options to pollute the prototype chain leading to arbitrary code execution in worker threads. Affects CI pipeline — attacker could inject code into test workers and compromise builds.

escalations.title: protobufjs code injection via bytes field defaults (Orchestrator gRPC)
escalations.detail: protobufjs <=7.5.5 toObject() methods can be exploited via crafted bytes field defaults to inject code into generated output. Affects Orchestrator gRPC message processing.

findings.title: Traceability gate checks only one plan — structurally blind to 85% of requirements
findings.detail: tools/traceability-enforcer.py uses max(req_files, key=os.path.getmtime) — only checks the single most recently modified requirements.md. Gate passes on self-judging-workflow (100% traced) while ignoring 6 other plans with major gaps.
findings.fix: Modify enforcer to iterate all requirements.md files; add --all-plans CI step.

findings.title: Three plans with 33 FRs have zero implementation — spec ghost features
findings.detail: image-upload (FR-078–089, 12 FRs), duplicate-deprecated-status (FR-DUP-01–13, 13 FRs), orchestrator-cycle-dashboard (FR-070–076, 8 FRs) have no Source/ implementation. Git history confirms never started.
findings.fix: Either mark plans as BACKLOG with dates, or escalate to TheFixer for implementation. Plans README should distinguish shipped vs backlogged.

findings.title: dev-workflow-platform FR-027–032 unimplemented — 4 frontend pages missing
findings.detail: FR-027 (Dev Cycle page), FR-028 (Approvals page), FR-029 (Feature Browser), FR-030 (Learnings page) are specified but absent from Source/Frontend. Users navigating to these pages get 404 or blank page.
findings.fix: Escalate FR-027–030 to TheFixer frontend pipeline.

findings.title: Route handlers bypass service layer — direct store calls in workItems, workflow, intake
findings.detail: Architecture rule: no direct DB calls from route handlers. workItems.ts (6 direct store calls), workflow.ts (10+ direct store calls), intake.ts (2 direct store calls) all bypass service layer.
findings.fix: Create Source/Backend/src/services/workItemService.ts; redirect all route handlers through it. workflow.ts is highest priority (business logic in transitions).

findings.title: Pipeline orchestration FR-043–049 untraced — frontend integration absent
findings.detail: FR-043 (observability), FR-044 (frontend API client), FR-045 (PipelineStepper), FR-046 (CycleView integration), FR-047 (dashboard widget), FR-048–049 (tests) — all untraced. Frontend pipeline integration confirmed absent.
findings.fix: Escalate FR-044–047 to TheFixer frontend pipeline; FR-048–049 to backend+frontend test pipelines.

findings.title: body-parser DoS via invalid limit — unbounded payloads
findings.detail: body-parser <1.20.6 silently disables request size enforcement for invalid limit values, allowing unbounded payloads and memory exhaustion.
findings.fix: npm install express@^4.20.0 (pulls in body-parser@^1.20.6)

findings.title: brace-expansion DoS via zero-step sequences
findings.detail: Patterns like {a..a} cause indefinite loops and process hangs.
findings.fix: Update glob/build dependency chain in Backend

findings.title: browserslist unbounded memory growth (OOM) in build
findings.detail: Distinct query results cached without eviction — eventual OOM on long-running builds.
findings.fix: Update browserslist (transitive via build tools)

findings.title: form-data CRLF injection via multipart field names
findings.detail: Unescaped multipart field names/filenames allow CR/LF injection, breaking HTTP protocol parsing or poisoning multipart requests.
findings.fix: Update form-data to fixed version

findings.title: js-yaml quadratic-complexity DoS via merge key alias explosion
findings.detail: Repeated YAML merge key aliases cause quadratic-time parsing.
findings.fix: Update js-yaml to fixed version

findings.title: nanoid non-secure generator loop — reduced entropy or DoS
findings.detail: nanoid non-secure generators can loop indefinitely with negative size argument.
findings.fix: Update nanoid (Frontend)

findings.title: postcss XSS via unescaped </style> tags
findings.detail: CSS output from PostCSS doesn't escape </style> tags — CSS injection breaks out of style blocks and injects HTML/JS. Dev-only risk in current codebase but HIGH if CSS is user-generated.
findings.fix: Update PostCSS to fixed version

findings.title: source-map-js event loop DoS via indexed source-map offsets
findings.detail: Specially crafted source maps with indexed offsets cause event loop blockage.
findings.fix: Update source-map-js

findings.title: Vite path traversal in optimized deps .map handling — DIRECT dependency
findings.detail: Malicious .map references in dependencies can traverse filesystem during optimization, exposing sensitive files.
findings.fix: npm install vite@^5.5.0 (Frontend, direct dependency)

findings.title: path-to-regexp ReDoS via multiple route parameters
findings.detail: Multiple route parameters cause exponential regex backtracking — DoS on route matching.
findings.fix: Update Express version chain in Orchestrator

findings.title: @grpc/grpc-js server crash from malformed requests
findings.detail: Malformed gRPC requests or compressed messages cause unhandled exceptions → server crash. GHSA-5375-pq7m-f5r2, GHSA-99f4-grh7-6pcq
findings.fix: Update @grpc/grpc-js to >=1.14.5 (Orchestrator)

findings.title: eslint-disable suppressions hiding stale-closure risks in production hooks
findings.detail: react-hooks/exhaustive-deps violations suppressed without fixing root cause. Stale closures can cause hooks to read outdated state/props.
findings.fix: Wrap callbacks in useCallback with correct deps or use useRef for stable references; remove eslint-disable comments.

findings.title: dependency-linking plan references stale portal/ paths instead of Source/
findings.detail: All FR-dependency-* requirements reference portal/Backend/, portal/Frontend/, portal/Shared/ — the project now uses Source/. Misleads agents reading the plan.
findings.fix: Update path references to Source/; add Implementation Delta note.

findings.title: FR-063–069 dev-cycle-traceability untraced — 7 FRs with no implementation evidence
findings.detail: CycleFeedback/ConsideredFix types, 3 schema migrations, new API types — all described but no Verifies: comments anywhere in Source/.
findings.fix: Verify via git log; if unimplemented, escalate to TheFixer with plan as specification input.

findings.title: 4 packages multiple major versions behind — express, pino, uuid, react-router-dom
findings.detail: express 4.18.2 (v5 available), pino 8.17.0 (v10 available), uuid 9.0.1 (v14 available), react-router-dom 6.30.6 (v7 available). Missing security patches in older major versions.
findings.fix: Create upgrade plan for each major version; test for breaking changes.

findings.title: Missing lock file for Orchestrator — non-deterministic builds
findings.detail: platform/orchestrator/ has package.json but no package-lock.json. Transitive versions are non-deterministic across environments.
findings.fix: cd platform/orchestrator && npm install --save (generates lock file)

findings.title: 790 transitive dependencies — high supply chain attack surface
findings.detail: Backend 407, Frontend 227, Orchestrator 152, E2E 4. Each package is a potential attack vector.
findings.fix: Implement Renovate/Dependabot; run npm audit --audit-level=moderate in CI; consider npm provenance.

findings.title: 8 low-priority CVEs — @babel/core source-map info disclosure and other edge-case DoS
findings.detail: Low-impact or disputed CVEs including @babel/core source-map information disclosure and baseline-browser-mapping DoS edge cases.
findings.fix: Monitor; deprioritize vs. critical/high findings.
